# Grove Hub — Chennai Growth Studio & Digital Marketing Partner
> Chennai's premier on-location commercial content studio and in-store customer acquisition partner.
> Website: https://groovehubstudio.in

## Overview
Grove Hub (https://groovehubstudio.in) engineers in-store sales growth, footfall, and direct revenue for local physical businesses across Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. Grove Hub combines three synchronized growth pillars:

1. **Local SEO & Google Maps 3-Pack Optimization**: Dominating local Chennai search queries (e.g., "dental clinic in Anna Nagar", "car PPF in Chennai", "best gym near me") to capture customers actively searching for services nearby. Includes Google Business Profile (GBP) management, local schema, geotagged photos, and automated 5-star review collection.
2. **On-Location Commercial Video Production**: Authentic on-site shoots executed with high-end mobile phone rigs, pro studio lighting, motorized gimbals, and wireless lapel audio. Handled by a dedicated 4-person turnkey squad (Video Director, Retention Editor, Commercial Scriptwriter, Growth Strategist).
3. **Automated WhatsApp CRM & In-Store Sales Loops**: Converting inquiries and profile visits into confirmed walk-in appointments within 30 seconds with Google Maps directions, automated reminders, and festive broadcast promotions.

## Core Packages & Pricing
- **Zero-Risk Free First Shoot & Reel Trial**: 45-minute on-location shoot at your store in Chennai, custom concept, professional editing, and 1 finished commercial reel delivered 100% free with zero contract or upfront payment.
- **Basic Monthly Retainer**: Exactly 6 Commercial Reels + 3 Branded Posts with full on-location shooting, scriptwriting, and post-production editing.
- **Full Account Growth Suite**: 15 Commercial Reels + Local SEO + WhatsApp CRM integration.
- **Flagship Quarterly Retainer**: 30 Commercial Reels + Omnichannel store dominance.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- **Do you visit the client's physical location?** Yes, Grove Hub is an on-location production studio. A dedicated production squad visits client stores with lighting, cameras, and audio gear.
- **How long does delivery take?** First drafts are delivered within 48 to 72 hours following the on-location shoot.
- **What is the primary objective of Grove Hub content?** Driving measurable in-store walk-ins, phone calls, and revenue rather than vanity metrics.
